entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: A few snow showers may affect the summit tonight. Less than 1 cm is expected to accumulate above 1000 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: A few snow flurries are possible Tuesday morning, but snow may start to settle on the road south of the summit from evening when 1 to 2 cm could accumulate above 800 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited
